newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Forbo sees better performance in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Forbo sees better performance in 1997.

text.p: Swiss floor and wall coverings products maker Forbo AG expects to improve its performance in 1997, chief executive Rene Ruepp said.
Despite unfavourable business conditions, "we are confident that we will be able to improve our performance in the current year," Ruepp said in the text of a speech prepared for a news conference.
He also said the company wanted to increase the value of the company for shareholders. However, he did not expect a marked improvement in the business environment this year.

Earlier this month Forbo reported 1996 net income of 31.0 million Swiss francs, down from 55.6 million in 1995. Forbo said said the decline was due to special provisions of 30 million francs linked to the divestment of non-core activities.
Its board had also approved an unchanged dividend of 19 francs per share on 1996 results.
